name: Process Management Workflow
description: Verifies the Processes tab: list population, grouping, search, sorting, selection, kill confirmation, guards, efficiency mode, and the Run-new-task dialog.

planSteps.description: Launch TaskManagerNative and open the Processes tab (default tab)
Assert the process table renders Apps, Background processes, and Windows processes sections with live row counts
Type a query into the global search field (e.g. 'Safari')
Assert only matching process rows (name, tab name, or working directory) remain visible
Click the CPU column header twice
Assert rows sort descending by CPU% then ascending
Select a row and click 'End task'
Assert a confirmation alert appears with the exact process name
Assert the process disappears on the next refresh and the End-task button clears selection
Attempt to end a critical/system process (e.g. WindowServer or PID 1)
Assert the app refuses with a visible error and does not attempt the kill
Assert all running app processes receive priority 10 (nice), and priority 0 when toggled off
Open the 'Run new task' dialog from the top bar
Assert typing a known app name opens it via LaunchServices; unknown input shows an error instead of executing arbitrary shell
Right-click a row and choose 'End Process Tree'
Assert SIGTERM then SIGKILL is sent to the real descendant subtree (walked by ppid), not an unrelated process group
